question.text: A PM wants to buy 1 million shares of a stock. Bid = Rs. 99, Offer = Rs. 101. What is the liquidity cost (assuming the full round-trip spread applied one-way)?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Half-spread concept: buying at ask (Rs. 101) vs mid (Rs. 100) = Rs. 1 per share one-way cost. Round-trip = Rs. 2. For a one-way transaction, cost = half the bid-ask spread. **The Trap:** Rs. 2 is the full round-trip spread; Rs. 99, 100 are prices themselves. **Cross-Exam Context:** VII (SORM) covers execution costs; XXI-B adapts for PM. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For large orders, use VWAP/TWAP algorithms to minimise impact cost on top of the headline spread.
